acceptanceCriteria: Each class gets a typed ownership classification (owned by a declared consumer, or explicitly unsupported with a code) instead of a generic unowned path.
Tests cover one path of each class.
body: Found by the 2026-10-20 read-only Beamfall setup review (corvint 1.0.0-rc.3 build 676; evidence under the session scratchpad beamfall-review/). Shader edits in beamfall-visual-shaders and beamfall-apple-ui, SQL migrations in core-history, and .github/workflows/*.py in every plugin repo yield only UNOWNED or UNINDEXED_SOURCE_PATH, never an owned class.
title: Ownership for non-adapter sources: GLSL/Metal shaders, SQL migrations and workflow-embedded scripts report only UNOWNED/UNINDEXED
